program: NFL-005 (shared worlds), NFL World Model V2 — second candidate; also NFL-003's Dirichlet-multinomial allocation rung
whyThisExists: The first NFL-005 look (nfl-005-shared-worlds-development.json) showed Sim V2's drive worlds are perfectly coherent but carry the drive engine's yardage biases into player marginals (DO_NOT_PROCEED x4 against allocV1 analytic). The analytic allocV1 marginals are accurate but not jointly coherent (8.2% of team-games have named receiving means > 1.1 x the passer's). This candidate generates joint team-game worlds AROUND allocV1's inputs: team volume, Dirichlet-multinomial allocation over the active players plus OTHER, binomial catches, gamma yards per opportunity, passing = sum of receiving by construction. It asks whether coherence can be had without losing accuracy.
evidenceTier: DEVELOPMENT. Test rows = P300's scored rows in 2019-2021 (inside the spent P299/P300 window and NFL-003's development look). Dev fits on 2022-2025. Outcome is only PROCEED_TO_FORWARD_SHADOW or DO_NOT_PROCEED per family.
whatTheAuthorHasSeenBeforeRegistering: NFL-003 development receipt; NFL-005 Sim V2 development receipt (both committed). No number from this candidate.

candidate.inputs: Exactly allocV1's (NFL-003 development receipt): reallocated shares per family with OTHER = 1 - sum(named) >= 0.02, team volumes V_pass, V_carries, V_targets from the dev-fitted volume model, shrunk catch rate / yards per reception / yards per carry per player (P300 estimators); OTHER uses league rates.
world: A = max(0, round(V_pass + sigmaPass * z1)); K = max(0, round(V_carries + sigmaRush * z2)); z1, z2 independent standard normal; sigma = P300's volumeSigmaPass 7.4689 / volumeSigmaRush 6.378.
T = round(A * V_targets / V_pass) (team targets move with team attempts).

Target probabilities p ~ Dirichlet(kappa_t * [named shares, OTHER]); target counts ~ Multinomial(T, p). Carries likewise with kappa_c over carry shares; pass attempts likewise with kappa_p over pass shares.

Receptions_i ~ Binomial(targets_i, catchRate_i); receiving yards_i ~ Gamma(shape = receptions_i * receivingShape, scale = ypr_i / receivingShape) (0 when no reception). Rushing yards_i ~ Gamma(carries_i * rushingShape, ypc_i / rushingShape). Shapes = P300's receivingShape 1.3741 and rushingShape 0.5619.

Team completions = sum of receptions (named + OTHER); team passing yards = sum of receiving yards (named + OTHER). Completions are split among passers ~ Multinomial(completions, realised attempt shares); passer i's passing yards = team passing yards * completions_i / completions.
candidate.fit: kappa_t, kappa_c, kappa_p each from the grid [2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 200] on dev (2022-2025) team-games, 600 runs each, choosing the value whose dev 80% coverage is closest to 0.80 for receptions (kappa_t), rushing yards (kappa_c) and passing yards (kappa_p); ties to the larger kappa. Receiving yards uses kappa_t.

comparator: allocV1 analytic, exactly as in nfl-003-opportunity-allocation-development.json (its dev scales), on identical rows.
population: P300's scored rows whose season is 2019-2021 and whose player is in the active pool of the simulated team-game.
invariants: Checked in EVERY run and every team-game; any violation aborts: allocated targets / carries / pass attempts (named + OTHER) equal the team totals; receptions <= targets per player; sum of receiving yards (named + OTHER) = team passing yards = sum of passer passing yards (within 1e-6); completions = sum of receptions.

proceedToForwardShadow_perFamily: non-inferiority: MAE <= allocV1 analytic MAE x 1.01
frozenBars.outcome: PROCEED_TO_FORWARD_SHADOW per family: the allocation worlds become that family's registered blind 2026 forward shadow generator (jointly coherent), compared with allocV1 analytic and the incumbent. Nothing public changes.
